<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that forms a sulfonamide (S–N bond) in the forward direction. The valid functional group name is “sulfonamides”. I will search the template catalog for templates that form this functional group, retrieve their details, and then check which one, when applied to the target molecule, gives the precursors ['CC(=O)O', 'Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/CNc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1']. Once the correct template is identified, I will obtain its mapped reaction SMILES and return it with the template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/CNc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
